title: Pairwise Feature-Match Matrix
written_solution: The output is a comparison matrix over the ordered objects. Each row-column pair reports a relation: identical object index on the diagonal, same symmetry class as cyan(8), same hole count (but different symmetry class) as yellow(4), and black(0) when neither relation holds.
